## 1200 - 1299

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01200">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1200 CV - DLL calculation failed</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01200">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data.

A DLL is used to calculate the Meter Flowing Density, Base Density, and Correction Factors (CTL, CPL, CTPL, etc). There are many data cases that may cause the Calculation DLL to fail. If the DLL is unable to calculate, for any reason, then this exception will be generated.

The exception description for this exception will be appended with text that further describes the reason that the DLL was unable to calculate. The following error messages can be appended to the exception description:

> </ul></td>
> </tr>
> </tbody>
> </table>

 

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="1201">

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01250">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1250 CV - Sum of component volumes does not match the edited sum of component volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01250">

This exception applies to manually created and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data.

FLOWCAL will compare the provided Summed Volume to the sum of the individual Component Volumes. If the values do not match out to the Product Discrimination for NSV units defined on the Discrimination tab in the Product Editor (Admin -\> FLOWCAL Options -\> Products) for that Product, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Product Discrimination for Bbl, which is the unit for NSV, is set to 2 decimal places for a Y-Grade product. A Meter ticket is created with Summed Volume set to 15324.178 Bbl. The sum of Component Volumes is 15327.174 Bbl. After rounding both values to 2 decimal places, the values do not match out to Product Discrimination so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01251">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1251 CV - Sum of net allowable volumes does not match the edited total net allowable volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01251">

This exception applies to manually created and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data.

FLOWCAL will compare the provided Total Net Allowable to the FLOWCAL calculated Sum of Net Allowable Volumes. If the values do not match out to the Product Discrimination for NSV units defined on the Discrimination tab in the Product Editor (Admin -\> FLOWCAL Options -\> Products) for that Product, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Product Discrimination for Bbl, which is the unit for NSV, is set to 2 decimal places for a Y-Grade product. A Meter ticket is created with Total Net Allowable set to 15324.178 Bbl. The FLOWCAL Calculated Sum of Net Allowable Volumes 15327.174 Bbl. After rounding both values to 2 decimal places, the values do not match out to Product Discrimination so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01252">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1252 CV - Liquid mass does not equal index difference</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01252">

This exception applies to imported Gas and Liquid Meter Data and Liquid Ticket Data.

FLOWCAL will compare the imported Mass to the difference of the imported Start and End Index for Mass. If these values do not match, then this exception will be generated.

For example, if a Gas meter record is imported with the following values:

- Mass Index Start = 20,745.235
- Mass Index End = 68,458.687
- Mass = 47713.450

The difference between the Start and End Index is 47713.452 (68458.687-20745.235), which is not equal to the imported Mass, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01253">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01253">

This exception applies to imported Gas Meters with a Calculation Method of AGA-7 or AGA-11, and Liquid Meters for all Meter Types other than Orifice, and Meter Tickets for all Meter Types other than Orifice.

FLOWCAL will compare the imported Pulses to the difference of the imported Start and End Index for Pulses. If these values do not match, then this exception will be generated.

For example, if a Gas meter record is imported with the following values:

- Pulses Index Start = 20,745
- Pulses Index End = 68,458
- Pulses = 47714

The difference between the Start and End Index is 47713 (68458-20745), which is not equal to the imported Pulses, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01260">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1260 CV - "Use analysis density as observed density if missing" is set, but neither density was found</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01260">

This exception applies to imported and edited Meter data and edited Ticket data.

For Meters, if the following criteria is met,

- The meter characteristic option Use Rel Dens from Analysis -\> As Observed, if Observed Dens is Missing is set to Y; or

<!-- -->

- The meter characteristic Use Rel Dens from Analysis -\> As Observed, if Observed Dens is Missing option is set to Use Product Config and the product Use Rel Dens from Analysis-\>As Observed, if Observed Dens is Missing option is checked for the time frame that includes the effective end date of the periodic where the density is being applied to.

But both the flow data record and the sample that is applied to the record does not have a Relative Density greater than 0, then this exception will be generated.

For all Ticket Types other than Inventory Empty and Cavern Level, if the Product Option ‘Use Rel Dens from Analysis’ option is set to “As Observed, if Observed Dens is Missing”, but the sample applied to the ticket does not have a Relative Density greater than 0, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01261">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1261 CV - "Use analysis density in TP-15 calculation" is set, but the analysis has no density</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01261">

For Meters, if the following criteria is met,

- The meter characteristic option Use Rel Dens from Analysis -\> In TP-15 Calc. Instead of Observed Density is set to Y; or
- The meter characteristic Use Rel Dens from Analysis -\> In TP-15 Calc. Instead of Observed Density option is set to Use Product Config and the product Use Rel Dens from Analysis-\>As Observed, if Observed Dens is Missing option is checked for the time frame that includes the effective end date of the periodic where the density is being applied to.

But the sample that is applied to the record does not have a Relative Density greater than 0, then this exception will be generated.

For Meter, Flare, Blow Down, and Product Conversion Tickets, if the Product Option ‘Use Rel Dens from Analysis’ option is set to “In TP-15 Calc. Instead of Observed Density”, but the sample applied to the ticket does not have a Relative Density greater than 0, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01262">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1262 CV - Unable to calculate correlation factor (IV is zero, calculated IV is non-zero)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01262">

This exception applies to Liquid Meter and Ticket data on import or an edit where the correlation factor is to be calculated.

When FLOWCAL attempts to calculate the IV correlation factor, on import or an edit where recalculate correlation factor is selected, if the provided value IV is 0 but FLOWCAL calculates a non-zero value for IV, then this exception will be generated and the IV correlation factor will not be calculated.

For example, if a Liquid Volumetric meter ticket is imported with Pulses = 1000, K Factor = 1, and IV = 0, then FLOWCAL will calculate an IV of 1000. Because the imported IV is 0 and the calculated IV is not zero, this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01263">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01263">

This exception applies to Tank Run and Vessel Tank tickets on import or an edit where the correlation factor is to be calculated.

When FLOWCAL attempts to calculate the open GSV correlation factor, if the provided open GSV is 0 but FLOWCAL calculates a non-zero value for open GSV, then this exception will be generated and the open GSV correlation factor will not be calculated.

For example, if a Tank Run ticket is imported with open GOV = 1000 and open GSV = 0 and FLOWCAL calculates open CTL = 1 and open GSV = 1000, then this exception will be generated because the imported open GSV is 0 and the calculated open GSV is not zero.

</div>

When FLOWCAL attempts to calculate the close SWV correlation factor, if the provided close SWV is a non-zero value but FLOWCAL calculates 0 for close SWV, then this exception will be generated and the close SWV correlation factor will not be calculated.

For example, if a Tank Run ticket is imported with close GSV = 1000, close NSV = 1000, and close SWV = 50, then FLOWCAL will calculate a close SWV of 0. Because the imported close SWV is not zero and the calculated close SWV is 0, this exception will be generated.

</div>
